g.text: Trade ingestion use case (shared by Kafka and REST): TradeIngestionService.ingest()
SELECT trade_id, version, expired FROM trades WHERE trade_id = ?
[0 rows: a higher version was committed concurrently (US-106)]
COMMIT (trade + outbox row, or outbox row only)
(LowerVersionException if LOWER_VERSION is among the reasons)
Thrown only AFTER the commit, so the
